changelog:
Neuralink Decoder Skill v1.0.0

- Simulates neural spike activity using a motor cortex cosine tuning model.
- Includes a linear decoder that translates spike rates into 2D cursor velocity.
- Generates and visualizes trajectories based on decoded cursor movements.
- Provides a decode command to run the full simulation and decoding loop.
summary: Simulates and decodes neural spike activity into cursor movement (BCI).
